Name: Setup and recruitment
Goal: Complete the cohort to fifteen committed participants and have a working programme environment in place before the first workshop in month 3. Deliverable: a confirmed cohort and a working programme environment.

Name: Core workshops and data-package delivery
Goal: Deliver the five workshops and the support hours between them, and host the organisational change workshop, so that each participant takes one of their own datasets to a published FAIR data package with a DOI. Lars Schöbitz leads the education; Adriana Clavijo Daza supports every workshop in person and technically and hosts selected modules towards the end of the programme. Deliverables: five workshops delivered, the hosted organisational change workshop, at least fifteen data packages in progress, support logged through issues.
Lead: Lars Schöbitz and Adriana Clavijo Daza

Name: Community building and outreach
Goal: Build an active cross-department community of practice around FAIR data and agentic AI workflows that reaches beyond the cohort. Adriana Clavijo Daza leads the day-to-day support channels, the Matrix channel, 1:1 calls and direct data support; outreach runs through the AI Playground, a public project website, blog posts and social media, and talks at RDM and reproducibility venues. Deliverable: an active cross-department community, a public record of the programme, and a record of events.
Lead: Lars Schöbitz and Adriana Clavijo Daza

Name: Consolidation, sustainability, and reporting
Goal: Publish the final data packages, capture the programme as a reusable offering, and feed the lessons back into the Data Stewardship Network. Deliverables: at least fifteen published FAIR data packages, a documented reusable programme, a DSN contribution, a draft data management strategy for each participant's group, final content and financial reports.
